reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

title.narrative: 2024 Syria Regional Appeal - Syria - Emergency Health
2024 Syria Regional Appeal - Syria - Emergency Health

description.narrative: A minimum of 900,000 visits to UNRWA health facilities are anticipated in 2024, with an additional 20,000 consultations facilitated through referrals to secondary and tertiary health care from a network of partner public and private hospitals supported by UNRWA. UNRWA has 24 health centres / health points and an additional three mobile clinics in Syria that provide primary health care services to Palestine refugees across the country. Two active phone lines will be supported under this EA allowing for the provision of 9,600 telemedicine consultations in 2024. The EA will also support persons with disabilities through the provision of 4,000 physiotherapy sessions and 500 assistive devices, including hearing aids. In addition, baby kits will be provided to 800 pregnant women for their newborn infants. UNRWA will continue to ensure that patients have adequate access to essential medicines and will strive to maintain contingency stocks of medical supplies and drugs to be accessed during an emergency. Under this appeal, UNRWA will conduct training for health staff to increase their preparedness for an emergency. Furthermore, as part of UNRWA’s commitment to AAP, training on community engagement and accountability will be organised for 50 UNRWA health staff and UNRWA volunteers from the refugee community.
